value.title: delete download
value.description: Delete session entries and data for jobId or jobIds. Each item checks output containment and records its own destructive audit, including failures. Returns a disk_deletion task in job. For download.delete, input jobId/jobIds identify downloads; the returned job.jobId identifies a separate deletion task. One user prompt covers the entire requested batch. Only a person clicking Delete in NipaPlay can authorize disk deletion. waiting_user means no deletion has run; task.wait and followup.register can observe it. A refusal fails with 用户没有同意删除. No confirmation or execute argument bypasses this gate.

value.title: 删除插件
value.description: 停用并删除本地插件脚本和索引；Classic 内置插件不能删除。 支持 operations 批量；每项可附 reason，成功项不会因其他项失败回滚。 Returns a disk_deletion task in job. Only a person clicking Delete in NipaPlay can authorize disk deletion. waiting_user means no deletion has run; task.wait and followup.register can observe it. A refusal fails with 用户没有同意删除. value.title: Remove a media source
value.description: Remove a source connection without confirmation. Indexed file identities, bindings and playback history remain; no disk files are deleted.

value.title: 恢复全量备份
value.description: 按选定类别调用 Classic .npb 恢复，会合并或改写持久数据。禁止设置保留现值并返回 forbidden_setting；注册设置经过 settings.set 的 Classic 校验与交互。凭据只能恢复本机已有引用，不能输入新的登录秘密。返回各类别实际结果；部分服务需要重启应用生效。来源记录保留本次调用者、时间与原因。 支持 operations 批量；每项可附 reason，成功项不会因其他项失败回滚。

value.title: danmaku.import
value.description: Import acquired danmaku using Classic local XML/JSON parsing and encoding support, including ARGB colors. Also accepts normalized JSON arrays (or {comments:[...]}): sourceTimeMs (nonnegative integer milliseconds), text, mode (positive integer), colorRgb (nonnegative integer, converted to RGB); optional platformId, sourceEntryId, originSource, sender, sentAt (strings), fontSize (positive integer). No registered source is required. Supply platform/platformVideoId; host records actor, origin and timestamp. Target entityId (file or episode), path, or current playback (default). Reimport replaces the same platform/video pool atomically, preserving track settings; empty or malformed files are rejected and leave the old track unchanged. Mounted immediately when the target is playing. File data stays in host storage; do not send large comment arrays through tool arguments.

value.title: Update account episode watch state
value.description: Mark a batch of episode IDs watched through Classic. Both providers accept only state=2, as in Classic episode progress. Each write is acknowledged independently.
